title: The Official Goop_Gooperpack
description: The custom resource pack of all time based around the twitch streamer goop_gooperson.
body:
Hi there! This is the official Goop_Gooperson Resource Pack!

![Lineup of the items with custom textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b94c6d36acdfb484e86b4951cd28908ffda9b58.png)

It replaces the textures of the slime, slime block, slime spawn egg, slime ball, golden apple, totem of undying and disc 13 with goop_gooperson themed textures.

It also replaces the sound effects of the slimes with custom recorded ones and the music of disc 13 with this [video here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2YQ9Re__HpY)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/zlsTZRwiJpM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

**Requires either Optifine of a mod with support for Custom Entity Models to see the Goop Slime model.**
